name: github_create_pull_request
description: Open a pull request. Provide `owner`, `repo`, `title`, `head` (the branch with your changes, e.g. 'feature-x' — or 'otherowner:branch' for a cross-fork PR), and `base` (the branch to merge into, e.g. 'main'); optional `body` (description) and `draft` (boolean). Returns the created PR including its `number` and `html_url`.

base.description: The branch you want to merge into (e.g. 'main').

draft.description: Optional — open as a draft PR.
